in_sanskrit.name: खिलेश्वर
in_sanskrit.meaning: The Lord of Khil (unknown god or power)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: खिल (Khil) is an unknown god or power, and ईश्वर (Eshwar) is the Lord of the Gods or the Lord of the Universe. So, Khileshwar is the Lord of the unknown god or power Khil.

in_hindi.name: खिलेश्वर
in_hindi.long_meaning: किले (Khil) is an unknown fort or place, and ईश्वर (Eshwar) is the Lord of that place or the Lord of the Universe. So, Khileshwar is the Lord of the unknown fort or place Khil.

in_tamil.name: கிலேஷவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: கில் (Kil) is an unknown place, and இஸ்வர (Isvara) is the Lord of that place or the Lord of the Universe. So, Khileshwar is the Lord of the unknown place Kil.

in_telugu.name: ఖిలేశ్వర
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఖిల (Khil) is an unknown god or power, and ఇశ్వర (Isvara) is the Lord of the Gods or the Lord of the Universe. So, Khileshwar is the Lord of the unknown god or power Khil.

in_marathi.name: Khileshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the battlefield
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khileshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Khileshwar is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Khila' which means 'battlefield' and 'Ishwar' which means 'Lord'. The name signifies a powerful warrior who is the Lord of the battlefield. This name is given to a boy who is believed to be brave, courageous and strong.
